question: If 2 is added to each odd digit and 1 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 3427165, which of the following digits will be third from the left in the new number thus formed?
solution:
**Given: **If 2 is added to each odd digit and 1 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 3427165.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2f3a849a04a155f46873ffc44c565d12a6b5be5fcc1fadaeac127e7b9b5e68b.png] 

Thus, 1 will be third from the left in the new number thus formed.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
